text.card: A red giant 1,419 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 15, give 1.17 solar masses and 12.3 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,454 K at its surface.
